\uplevel{\textbf{Part II. Multiple choice}}

\question[2] Solve $x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0$.
\begin{choices}
  \choice $x = 1, 6$
  \CorrectChoice $x = 2, 3$
  \choice $x = -2, -3$
  \choice $x = 5, 6$
\end{choices}

\question[2] Which is the axis of symmetry of $y = 2x^2 - 8x + 1$?
\begin{choices}
  \choice $x = -2$
  \choice $x = 4$
  \CorrectChoice $x = 2$
  \choice $x = 8$
\end{choices}
\begin{solution}
  $x = -b/(2a) = 8/4 = 2$.
\end{solution}

\question[2] The discriminant of $x^2+4x+4$ is
\begin{oneparchoices}
  \CorrectChoice $0$ \choice $4$ \choice $8$ \choice $16$
\end{oneparchoices}

Which equation matches?
